title: Selecting duration of no announcements for carbs required does not work correctly
symptom: No matter which duration is selected (5, 15, or 30 minutes) for the 'no announcements for carbs required' feature, the result is always 30 minutes. The user suspects that all three possibilities get added to the intent, but each subsequent set overwrites the previous one, so the last option always wins.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state the root cause, but the user's suspicion is that all three durations are added to the intent and the last one overwrites the previous ones, leading to always 30 minutes.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit referenced by MilosKozak: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/147c9f27f5fe9cf1f23de4ef0d4b5bc125432e3b
